name: pr_decision
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

gate.description: The WAIT gate's payload. Read fields: action ('approve'|'revise'|'stop', or inferred 'approve' from approved=true), approved (bool), feedback (string), title/body or artifact.title/artifact.body.

fallbackTitle.description: Used as 'title' output when the gate provides neither gate.title nor gate.artifact.title.

fallbackBody.description: Used as 'body' output when the gate provides neither gate.body nor gate.artifact.body.

action.description: Reduced gate decision: 'approve' only when gate.action is 'approve' (or approved=true), 'revise'/'stop' when requested with non-blank feedback where required, else 'unknown'.

feedback.description: Feedback text taken from gate.feedback, empty string if absent.

title.description: gate.title, or gate.artifact.title, or fallbackTitle, in that order; may be null if none supplied.

body.description: gate.body, or gate.artifact.body, or fallbackBody, in that order; may be null if none supplied.
